title: obs.report params (receiver report, AWP-OBS-007)
description: Agent-side delivery quality, staleness, and decision latency aggregated over the preceding window.

rtt_ns.description: Round-trip time of the selected sample; the offset error is bounded by rtt_ns / 2.

samples.description: Exchanges completed so far in the session.

channels.description: Per observation channel that delivered frames in the window.

gaps.description: Frames missing, by seq; the gap before a resync frame is not counted (AWP-DAT-009).

jitter_ns.description: Mean of |(R_j − R_i) − (S_j − S_i)| over consecutive frames; R is the agent clock at receipt, S is ts_send_ns.

staleness_ns.description: Staleness at receipt: (agent receipt + offset_ns) − ts_mono_ns.

decision_latency_ns.description: Agent receipt of the basis frame → action.submit transmitted, over submissions in the window.
